name: Agent Failure Diagnostic
buyer_input: One non-confidential sentence plus an optional locally generated triage packet.
deliverable: A known / unknown / not-tested diagnosis, one stop / retry / rollback recommendation, and a Markdown + JSON receipt.
acceptance: the buyer sentence is reproduced exactly
known, unknown, and not-tested facts are separated
one stop, retry, or rollback recommendation is explicit
the buyer receives both Markdown and JSON
the receipt makes no certification claim
refund: If the agreed one-business-day clock is missed after payment evidence, refund the diagnostic fee.
out_of_scope: buyer credentials or private production access
